TEXT:
    WITH plan AS (
        SELECT * FROM unnest(%(wonums)s::varchar[], %(starts)s::timestamp[], %(finishes)s::timestamp[],
                             %(authors)s::varchar[], %(descriptions)s::varchar[])
            AS p(wonum, actual_start, actual_finish, author, description)
    ), completed AS (
        UPDATE cmms_indianapolis.work_orders AS wo
        SET status = %(status)s, actual_start = p.actual_start, actual_finish = p.actual_finish
        FROM plan p
        WHERE wo.wonum = p.wonum AND wo.wonum LIKE %(prefix)s
          AND wo.status = ANY(%(open_statuses)s) AND wo.reported_date < %(loop_start)s
          AND wo.reported_by = %(reported_by)s AND wo.description = p.description
        RETURNING wo.wonum, GREATEST(p.actual_finish, wo.reported_date) AS log_date,
                  COALESCE(p.author, %(default_author)s) AS author
    )
    INSERT INTO cmms_indianapolis.work_order_log (wonum, log_date, author, log_type, entry)
    SELECT wonum, log_date, left(author, 60), 'COMPLETE', %(entry)s FROM completed

TEXT:
    WITH pipeline_production AS (
        SELECT product_id, site,
               COALESCE(SUM(planned_quantity), 0) as total_pipeline
        FROM production_runs
        WHERE status IN ('PLANNED', 'RELEASED', 'IN_PROGRESS')
        GROUP BY product_id, site
    )
    SELECT p.product_id, p.sku, p.product_name,
           COALESCE(ib.quantity_on_hand, 0) as current_inventory,
           COALESCE(pp.total_pipeline, 0) as pipeline_production,
           s.site_code
    FROM products p
    JOIN inventory_items ii ON p.product_id = ii.product_id AND ii.item_type = 'FINISHED_GOOD'
    JOIN product_site_routing psr ON p.category = psr.product_category AND psr.is_active = TRUE
    JOIN sites s ON psr.site_id = s.site_id AND s.is_active = TRUE AND s.site_code != 'BOTTLING_PLANT'
    LEFT JOIN inventory_locations il ON il.location_code = (
        CASE s.site_code WHEN 'MILWAUKEE_BOTTLING' THEN 'MKE-FG' WHEN 'DETROIT_AUTOPARTS' THEN 'DET-FG' WHEN 'CEDARRAPIDS_FOOD' THEN 'CR-FG' WHEN 'INDIANAPOLIS_MACHINING' THEN 'IND-FG' WHEN 'BOTTLING_PLANT' THEN 'FG-WAREHOUSE' ELSE 'FG-WAREHOUSE' END
    ) AND il.is_active = TRUE
    LEFT JOIN inventory_balances ib ON ii.item_id = ib.item_id AND ib.location_id = il.location_id
    LEFT JOIN pipeline_production pp ON p.product_id = pp.product_id AND pp.site = s.site_code
    WHERE p.is_active = TRUE
      AND (COALESCE(ib.quantity_on_hand, 0) + COALESCE(pp.total_pipeline, 0)) < %s
    ORDER BY (COALESCE(ib.quantity_on_hand, 0) + COALESCE(pp.total_pipeline, 0)) ASC
production.complete_production backlog:
TEXT:
    SELECT pr.run_id, pr.run_number, pr.actual_quantity, p.sku, pr.site,
           fg.location_code, fg.location_id, fi.item_id
    FROM production_runs pr
    JOIN products p ON p.product_id = pr.product_id
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT il.location_id, il.location_code
        FROM inventory_locations il
        WHERE il.location_code = (CASE pr.site WHEN 'MILWAUKEE_BOTTLING' THEN 'MKE-FG' WHEN 'DETROIT_AUTOPARTS' THEN 'DET-FG' WHEN 'CEDARRAPIDS_FOOD' THEN 'CR-FG' WHEN 'INDIANAPOLIS_MACHINING' THEN 'IND-FG' WHEN 'BOTTLING_PLANT' THEN 'FG-WAREHOUSE' ELSE 'FG-WAREHOUSE' END) AND il.is_active = TRUE
        LIMIT 1
    ) fg
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT ii.item_id
        FROM inventory_items ii
        WHERE ii.product_id = pr.product_id AND ii.item_type = 'FINISHED_GOOD'
        LIMIT 1
    ) fi
    WHERE pr.status = 'COMPLETED'
      AND pr.actual_quantity IS NOT NULL
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM inventory_transactions it
          WHERE it.reference_type = 'PRODUCTION_RUN'
            AND it.reference_id = pr.run_id
            AND it.transaction_type = 'RECEIPT'
      )
    ORDER BY pr.actual_end_time NULLS FIRST, pr.run_number
    LIMIT %s
    FOR UPDATE OF pr SKIP LOCKED

TEXT:

        priority, pm_num, reported_by, reported_date, target_start, sched_start,
        actual_start, actual_finish, failure_code, crew)
    VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s)
    ON CONFLICT (wonum) DO UPDATE SET status = EXCLUDED.status,

        sched_start = EXCLUDED.sched_start, actual_start = EXCLUDED.actual_start,
        actual_finish = EXCLUDED.actual_finish

    WITH logged AS (

        JOIN unnest(%(priors)s::varchar[], %(entries)s::text[]) AS m(prior, entry) ON l.entry = m.entry
    ), restored AS (
        UPDATE cmms_indianapolis.work_orders AS wo SET status = logged.prior,
            description = CASE WHEN right(wo.description, length(%(suffix)s)) = %(suffix)s
                THEN left(wo.description, length(wo.description) - length(%(suffix)s))
                ELSE wo.description END
        FROM logged WHERE wo.wonum = logged.wonum AND wo.status = 'CAN'
        RETURNING wo.wonum

    WHERE entry = ANY(%(entries)s) AND wonum IN (SELECT wonum FROM restored)
